newsitem.title: USA: U.S. House panel clears DC revitalization plan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. House panel clears DC revitalization plan.

text.p: A key U.S. House subcommittee on Thursday unanimously approved broad legislation to revitalize the financially struggling District of Columbia that includes most of the elements of a Clinton administration proposal made earlier this year.

The bill, which would turn over funding of the city's pension liability, 70 percent of its Medicaid costs, and prison expenses to the U.S. government, could reach the full House for a vote as early as next week, said Rep. Tom Davis, R - Va.
